newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy mini-budget likely on March 28 - minister.
newsitem.headline: Italy mini-budget likely on March 28 - minister.

text.p: The Italian cabinet is likely to unveil its awaited mini-budget for 1997 at a cabinet meeting on March 28, Agriculture Minister Michele Pinto said after the cabinet met on Friday.

He said full quarterly state accounts, which will determine the size of the package in order to correct an overshoot of the 1997 target deficit, had not been ready for Friday's meeting but that Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi had made a report to the cabinet. Italian media say the mini-budget is likely to contain deficit-cutting measures of at least 15 trillion lire.
